data.dev: AF-05 dev 224 canonical cases depth2/3 layout3, only qualification
data.fitting: AF-05 train 672 canonical cases, depth2/3 layouts0/1/2
data.no_leakage: derived relay, Q and goal truth never enter model features; heldout labels excluded from fitting/checkpoint selection
data.scope: same Horn logical rule templates; independent unused physical permutation IDs

eval.fit_eligibility: relay_final and closure_rollout each >=.90 goal AND exact joint-Q on both train and dev independently; seed-specific
eval.lean: Boolean primitive and prospective closed Boolean-Horn theorem certifications are oracle-only, not neural theorem proof claims
eval.primary: Within every eligible seed/family closure_rollout - relay_final joint-Q exact >=.05, final-atom accuracy >=.05, closure goal accuracy >=relay_final-0.03, influence-patch accuracy >=relay_final-0.03, no more false goal positives, irrelevant-patch goal-retention >=.90. Eligible fail -> aggregate fail; all seeds eligible and pass -> aggregate pass; else inconclusive.
eval.replay: independent per-case Horn closure reconstructed from actual rule bytes, metrics recomputed from raw logits, source .pt/.npz equality, per-seed two sampled cases per family and arm replayed from weights

failure_policy: scientific pass/fail separate from engineering CI; retain every ineligible negative outcome, original AF01..11 results and source unchanged

fit.checkpoints: fixed final step; all three arm .pt and named NumPy .npz plus train/dev logits; no early stop
fit.closure_rollout: common_loss + 0.35 weighted all-atom stagewise Horn CE + 0.15 probability monotonicity MSE
fit.common_loss: AF11 full addressed counterfactual-cut common CE on clean goal/Q, patched goal/Q and unaffected-patch negative control
fit.fairness: same native recurrent forward-call counts per case and optimizer updates, extra loss/backward FLOPs not matched
fit.relay_final: common_loss + 0.35 weighted all-atom CE after final prefix recurrence
fit.source_init: Each arm copies same original AF-06 qualified checkpoint, with independent same donor/sampler seed; no adaptation from AF-11 heldout scores
fit.terminal: common_loss only, trace prefix still computed for forward-call balance
fit.weighting: positive Horn membership labels weight2, negative labels weight1; equal over all atoms/stages and sampled cases

math.closure: S[t+1] = S[t] union {head(rule): prem(rule) subset of S[t]}
math.general_theorem: inflationary, monotone, stabilizes in at most |atoms| strict-growth iterations; independent mathematical induction
math.lean_scope: Lean 4.19.0 checks finite Boolean AND/OR monotonicity primitives and closed Horn source instances; no general set-theoretic mechanization claimed
math.relay_stage_labels: status of all 15 physical atom slots after each synchronous upstream Horn closure step, ground truth from independent rule expansion

model.cut: AF-10 exact structural Q-code latch during all downstream calls, identical in arms

parent.model: AF-05 GraphLooper with original pinned TypedLoop cell; 29 typed tokens each with two carried float32 coordinates; unmodified source
parent.source: original qualified AF-06 width-2 seed17/29 checkpoints
parent.starting_qualification: both parent warm-ups already 1.000 train/dev goal and exact joint-Q
